name: Life spaceship d02b5ce8 on 2-uniform tiling k2-012
description: A period-3 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 2-uniform tiling k2-012, with touching neighbours, 10 to 14 cells, moving one lattice step every 3 generations (c/3). It runs the same way in the 131,072 rules from B3/S23 to B3,7,9,10,11,12,13,14/S0,2,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14. JETCARP's Life census met it in one of its 50,000 soups on this tiling.
